I am the oldest of the four sisters.|Tera|BotW}} * [[Great Fairy Kaysa]] {{Small|(second-eldest sister)}}{{Cite|I hear that my big sister Kaysa is at a stable near the Gerudo region to the west.|Great Fairy Cotera|TotK}} * [[Great Fairy Mija]] {{Small|(third-eldest sister)}}{{Cite|I hear that my big sister Mija is near a stable in the Hebra region northwest of here.|Great Fairy Cotera|TotK}}}} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Great Fairy Cotera||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}{{Cite|Great Fairy Cotera|Game Screen|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Cotera||BotW, AoC}},{{Exp Game|BotW, AoC}}{{Cite|Cotera|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color AoC|Red|Cotera}}|Game Screen|AoC}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Cotera is a [[Great Fairy]] living in [[West Necluda]]. Her [[Cotera's Great Fairy Fountain|Great Fairy Fountain]] is located on the [[East Hill]] near [[Kakariko Village]]. Like the other Great Fairies, [[Cotera]] will upgrade [[Link]]'s [[Armor]] in exchange for [[Material]]s. According to [[Dorian]], [[Cotera]] is also said to be a guardian spirit of Kakariko Village, though few remain in the village who know of her.{{Cite Book|quote=|book=CaC|publisher=|page=368}} [[Cotera]] is at least 10,000 years old, as she was around during the first [[Great Calamity]]. Soon after, she watched over the construction of Kakariko Village. When first meeting [[Cotera]], she is cocooned in a thorny flower bud and begs [[Link]] to listen as she explains her sad state.{{Cite|Boy... Sweet boy... Please... Listen to my story...|Cotera|BotW}} If he agrees, she introduces herself and tells him about her home.{{Cite|[Sure.] I am the Great Fairy Cotera... This place was once a beautiful spring...|Cotera|BotW}} A lack of travelers and offerings have left her utterly drained, giving her no choice but to ask for [[Link]]'s help.{{Cite|But as time passed, fewer and fewer travelers arrived to offer me rupees. As a result, my power has abandoned me. I'm nearly powerless now, so I beg your help. I need rupees to become whole again.|Cotera|BotW}} She requests several [[Rupee]]s from [[Link]]. The number changes based on how many Great Fairies [[Link]] has already helped.{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}...|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}}...|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}...|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|10,000 rupees}}...|Cotera|BotW}} [[Cotera]] assures [[Link]] that she will aid him once she is back to her old self and extends a hand from the bud to accept his offering.{{Cite|Once my power has been restored, I can help you do great things, boy. Now... If you have rupees, hand them over to me. Quickly!|Cotera|BotW}} Should [[Link]] refuse to help her, she retracts her hand with disappointment.{{Cite|[I'll keep my rupees.] That is truly tragic...|Cotera|BotW}} Once [[Link]] gives her the appropriate amount of Rupees, [[Cotera]] thanks him and is able to regain her power.{{Cite|Thank you. You are too kind. Aah... The power... {{Big|It's overflowing!!!}}|Cotera|BotW}} She bursts from the renewed [[Great Fairy Fountain]] completely refreshed, expressing her joy.{{Cite|HAHHHHH... Oh, what a feeling! That first breath of fresh air after an eternity of decay... It's just so intoxicating!|Cotera|BotW}} To thank him for his part in her rejuvenation, [[Cotera]] offers her assistance to [[Link]] in the form of enhancing his [[Armor]].{{Cite|Thanks to you, I've been returned to my former glory. And as they say—one good turn deserves another. I can help you, boy. Allow me to {{Color BotW|Red|enhance}} your {{Color BotW|Red|clothing}}. It's the least I can do, but I will need the necessary {{Color BotW|Red|materials}}...|Cotera|BotW}} How much Cotera will be able to enhance Link's Armor depends on how many of her sisters have been assisted.{{Cite|With the power available to me... I should be able to enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a little bit}}.|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a fair amount}}.|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can {{Color BotW|Red|greatly}} enhance your clothing.|Cotera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|to the max}}!|Cotera|BotW}} Whenever [[Cotera]] uses her power, she urges [[Link]] to allow her to handle the work.{{Cite|All right, let me do my thing!|Cotera|BotW}} [[Cotera]] will occasionally mention set bonuses when she enhances [[Link]]'s clothing, pointing out how they work.{{Cite|All finished! Just a bit stronger... Oh... You've heard about set bonuses, right? How a set of clothes that have all been enhanced twice could have a bonus? But only if you wear the whole set! Well, and not all sets have a bonus...|Cotera|BotW}} Once [[Link]] decides to stop, [[Cotera]] will mention her sisters and request that he help them as well.{{Cite|I have sisters out there in the world. Like me, they've lost much of their power. If you were able to restore power to them as well, we'd be able to {{Color BotW|Red|enhance your clothing even more}}... See you later...|Cotera|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Characters |category= |needs= * Detailed information on the character's role in the story, including what quests they are involved in * Detailed information on where the character lives and travels to, including at what times they can be found in those locations }} {{Quests| {{TotK Quest |name= Serenade to Cotera |type= Side Adventure |giver= [[Mastro]] |location= [[Dueling Peaks Stable]] }} }} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Cotera appears as a [[Boss]] in the [[Challenge]] "[[Fairy Fountain: Grassy Plains]]" after completing the [[Quest]] "[[Offering Help on the Road]]". Once the [[Warrior]]s have also completed "[[Fairy Fountain: Deep Snows]]", "[[Fairy Fountain: Desert Sands]]", and "[[Fairy Fountain: Battlefield]]", Cotera will be unlocked as a playable Warrior alongside her sisters and [[Malanya]].{{Cite|{{Big|'''Great Fairies'''}}
